observed_problem: Survey Production Core v2 has a generic stage plan, Stage Handoff Request/Handoff contracts, one-stage adoption driver, and handler/validator registry, but the repository assistant-control allowlist still exposes only legacy Weekly/Special production workflows and the v2 WORKFLOW_DISPATCH stage does not name a settled external workflow authority.
expected_behavior: After the coherent candidate is merged to main, a fresh W33 or SP001 session must be able to use explicit allowlisted v2 production entrypoints, with external workflow dispatches named and bounded by the same State/Profile/Action Spec authority rather than relying on chat-history knowledge or an unregistered legacy path.
actual_behavior: assistant-control.yml contains no Core v2 production entrypoint. The FROZEN stage is classified WORKFLOW_DISPATCH but config/survey-production-v2.json records only handler stage:release, so the operational dispatcher has no canonical workflow identity to authorize.
production_workaround: External W33/SP001 production remains blocked until the coherent Core v2 candidate is Human-reviewed and merged; canonical v2 control/release workflows and assistant-control allowlisting are implemented on this branch.
improvement_action: Define canonical v2 production workflow identities in the contract, add an allowlisted one-stage production/adoption workflow and a release workflow boundary, and add W33/SP001 bootstrap regressions proving both Profiles resolve the same complete stage/control graph without starting a Pilot.
